synopsis: Star Wars: The Mandalorian is a Canon children's book published by Studio Fun International, an adaptation of the first season of the television series The Mandalorian. Relive the first season of The Mandalorian as Mando, Cara Dune, Kuill, and Greef Karga attempt to save the Child from Moff Gideon and what remains of the Galactic Empire in this beautiful storybook.After the stories of Jango and Boba Fett, another warrior emerges in the Star Wars universe. The Mandalorian is set after the fall of the Empire and before the emergence of the First Order. We follow the travails of a lone gunfighter in the outer reaches of the galaxy far from the authority of the New Republic. Star Wars fans of all ages will enjoy reliving the first season of The Mandalorian in this beautiful storybook.
title: The Mandalorian: Volume 1(Disney Die-Cut Classics)
